verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Batch Processing API for high-volume processing, asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, and bulk exports by type and date range. But the batch API is only a one-line mention, and the monitoring configuration endpoints work on a single customer at a time. Missing for 10: documented batch API semantics (payload limits, supported operation types, per-item error handling), bulk case/alert decisioning or bulk monitor/unmonitor, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
